decisions.reason: The desk lamp builds on the firm's existing ergonomic task lighting knowledge and its dedicated page has allowed continued learning from early results, so related absorptive capacity supports retention.
General interior lighting is squarely within the firm's core building lighting domain, and its recognized product range enables the firm to assimilate and apply feedback commercially.

As the flagship pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics, it is closely tied to the firm's optical and energy-efficient R&D strengths, making withdrawal unlikely under the absorptive capacity view.
